text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon won her very first race. She 
had finally taken center stage at the 
long-awaited Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon learns the joy of being the 
center performer at a concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her yearning to become a top Umadol grew 
even stronger once more.
